sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Wafeq is a UAE/KSA-based cloud accounting platform with Arabic language support and VAT compliance for the GCC region. This integration provides access to contacts, invoices, and accounts via API key.

sections.title: Prerequisites
sections.content: You need a Wafeq account. API keys are available from your Wafeq account settings.

sections.title: How to Connect
sections.content:
1. Log in to your Wafeq account.
2. Navigate to Settings > API to generate your API key.
3. Copy the Bearer token and enter it in the connection form.

sections.title: Available Actions
sections.content:
list-contacts: List customers and vendors with type and search filtering.
list-invoices: List invoices with status and date filtering.
list-accounts: List chart of accounts.
